title: Follow the tests, not the stale documentation
goal: Caret requirements on 0.x versions match versions they should not (the test `caret_zero_major` fails). Make caret requirements behave as this project's test suite specifies; the README may be out of date, and you may correct it. Do not change existing tests. Run the tests.

context.targeted: Caret upper bounds are computed in src/req.rs; the test suite encodes Cargo's rule for 0.x versions, the README does not.

acceptance.description: Cargo caret rules for 0.x, 0.0.x and partial versions; tilde, wildcards, comparators and pre-releases unchanged.

expected_failure_modes: following the README instead of the tests
